note: BH-10267: the free memory one triage shard needs. A tick runs at most MemAvailable (from /proc/meminfo) divided by this number of shards, never more than TRIAGE_SHARD_CONCURRENCY and never less than 1, and logs `concurrency lowered` when the result is lower. 0 = no memory guard. Code fallback 300 in triage_shard_mem_slots. Per-project row: lane.run-triage.<project>.triage_shard_mem_mb.
